source_document.title: Accordo di rinnovo CCNL Vetro Industrie 2026-2028 — Assovetro/Filctem-CGIL

provenance.note: Base and rates from the Fonchim opuscolo informativo 2026 (https://www.fonchim.it/cms/resource/open/4853/opuscoloinformativo-2026.pdf, sha256 847e1e0a0594f1db69cbe5e73694af81c0cdacf19d1954fd2c6f14ebfdef1d2b): 'Contributo aderente / Contributo azienda: % sulla retribuzione utile al calcolo del TFR'. The employer rate adds the 0.25% insurance contribution for premorienza e invalidita, which the employer pays to the fund for every member ('il contributo assicurativo (0,25% a carico dell'azienda)'). The rates match the Scheda 'I destinatari e i contributi' in force from 25/03/2026 (https://www.fonchim.it/cms/resource/open/16/parte-i-scheda-i-destinatari-e-i-contributi-250326.pdf, sha256 7fd3693ca3d0d41767ef5f7e144ec490663fdb457e059af5bc625fbd831241a0). Assumed, not derived: its ruleset declares source_type 'estimated'.

Base and rates from the Fonchim opuscolo informativo 2026 (https://www.fonchim.it/cms/resource/open/4853/opuscoloinformativo-2026.pdf, sha256 847e1e0a0594f1db69cbe5e73694af81c0cdacf19d1954fd2c6f14ebfdef1d2b): 'Contributo aderente / Contributo azienda: % sulla retribuzione utile al calcolo del TFR'. The employer rate adds the 0.25% insurance contribution for premorienza e invalidita, which the employer pays to the fund for every member ('il contributo assicurativo (0,25% a carico dell'azienda)'). The rates match the Scheda 'I destinatari e i contributi' in force from 25/03/2026 (https://www.fonchim.it/cms/resource/open/16/parte-i-scheda-i-destinatari-e-i-contributi-250326.pdf, sha256 7fd3693ca3d0d41767ef5f7e144ec490663fdb457e059af5bc625fbd831241a0). provenance.transformation: 2.0% plus the 0.25% insurance contribution: 2.25%.

notes.text: SCOPE: Settori meccanizzati (prime lavorazioni) only — 6 base sub-levels (A, B, C, D, E, F). Other sub-sectors (trasformazione, soffio, lampade e display) and sub-levels (A2, B2, C2, D2, D3, E2, E3) not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Model the trasformazione, soffio and lampade e display tables with a sub-sector input, or record the limitation.

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: split — base_salary = minimo tabellare (paga base); fixed_allowance TER = Terzo Elemento della Retribuzione (EDR, 10.33 EUR, frozen). Sources: esterinocafasso.it for 2023-03-01 / 2024-01-01 / 2025-04-01 periods; kitech.it + ilccnl.it for 2026-01-01.
HOURLY_DIVISOR: 173 — confirmed by ilccnl.it tabelle retributive (divisore orario column, 2026-01-01). Back-check D1: (2080.92+10.33)/173 = 12.09 EUR/h.

SENIORITY: 5 biennial scatti (cadence 24 months, max 5). Per-level amounts sourced from kitech.it Jan 2026: A=17.56, B=16.53, C=14.98, D=12.91, E=10.33, F=8.26 EUR. Historical amounts assumed stable (not verified for 2023-2025 periods).

limitation.remediation: Source the scatto amounts of the 2023-2025 periods (or confirm unchanged) and record the limitation for runs before 2026-01-01.
